question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Resolves on Apple's total net sales for fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ended about Sep 26, 2026). Prior research says the report is due Nov 2, 2026 (MacRumors, Oct 6); some aggregators list Oct 29. Guidance from the Jul 30 call is +9% to +11% on $102.47B, or $111.7-113.7B, including a 2.5pt FX headwind and heavier supply constraints. The last four quarters landed at or above the guide midpoint, except FQ4'25, which came in at the bottom. Consensus is about $113.6B (27 analysts, range $112.25-117.2B). I set the median at about $113.85B (+11.1%). Risk of landing below $112B is about 8%; above $118B is about 3%, which needs a big beat despite the supply limits. No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market was found, either by the harness or in earlier runs; I couldn't search this time because my web tools failed. Thin, unverified evidence keeps me close to the guide and consensus.

calls.reasoning: This resolves on Apple's reported fiscal Q4 2026 total net sales. The quarter ended Sep 26, so the number is fixed but not yet published; the release is expected about Nov 2. On Jul 30 Apple guided +9-11% on $102.47B, or $111.7-113.7B (midpoint $112.7B). That guide already includes a ~2.5pt FX headwind and significantly worse supply constraints. In the unconstrained Dec and Mar quarters Apple beat its guide midpoint by +5 and +2.5pp. In the constrained Sep-25 and Jun-26 quarters it landed near the midpoint (-1 and +0.8pp). Since this quarter is explicitly more constrained, I put the median near the top of the guide rather than above it: $113.5B (+10.8%), close to the ~$113.6B consensus. Below $112B means landing at or under the guide floor, ~8%. Above $118B means a ~+15% print despite the supply caps, ~2%. Market check: none of the runs or the harness found a Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market, and I could not search on this run.
calls.reconciliation: Factual items: all three dossiers agree on the guide (+9-11% on $102.47B), the guide-vs-actual history, the ~$113.6B Yahoo consensus (27 analysts, $112.25-117.2B), and that the release is due ~Nov 2. The unclear $115.06B tradingpedia figure cannot be checked without web access; it is uncorroborated, so I gave it little weight. The release date vs the Oct 29 scheduled resolution cannot be settled here, but it affects only timing, not the value. Judgment item: whether the median should sit above the guide top. All runs put it at ~$113.7-113.85B. Weighting the two constrained-regime quarters, where outcomes landed near the guide midpoint, and given Apple's statement that constraints are worse this quarter, I put the median slightly lower at $113.5B, essentially at consensus. I kept tail escape masses similar to the runs (8%/2%) and set the width from constrained-regime surprise dispersion.

disagreements.claim: Median should sit ~$113.7-113.85B (above the guide top)
